Maps the vertical structure of a forest from the height distribution of the lidar points: no forest, single layer, single layer of variable height or double layer.

**Toolbox folder:** Lesto › filter<br>
**Status:** Experimental<br>
**Keywords:** las, distribution<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.lesto.modules.filter.LasHeightDistribution`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inIndexFile` | LAS file |  |  | The lidar data: a las file, the index file of a folder of las files created by LasIndexer or a las database. |
| `inDem` | raster file |  |  | The elevation model of the ground: the heights of the points are taken over it, and the categories are mapped on its cells. |
| `inVector` | vector file |  |  | The tiles to analyze, as polygons with an id: the height distribution is analyzed in each tile. |
| `pThres` | double | m | `2.0` | The minimum height of the points over the ground: the lower points, as the ground and the low vegetation, are not used. |
| `pOverlapPerc` | double | % | `80.0` | The minimum percentage of the cells of a layer that have points also in the next layer, to call the forest of the tile double layered. |
| `fId` | String |  | `id` | The field of the id of the tiles. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outCats` | output file |  | The raster of the categories of the forest: 0 no forest, 1 single layer, 2 single layer of variable height, 3 double layer. |
